# eslint-plugin-browser-security

Guide for AI coding assistants using this plugin in a project. To change the plugin's own source, read https://github.com/ofri-peretz/eslint/blob/main/AGENTS.md instead.

> ESLint browser security and XSS rules — detects DOM XSS, postMessage abuse, tokens in localStorage, insecure cookies, clickjacking, mixed content, and CSP gaps.

## Enable it

```bash
npm install --save-dev eslint-plugin-browser-security
```

Requires ESLint ^8.40.0 || ^9.0.0 || ^10.0.0 and Node >=22.13.0.

Flat config files (`eslint.config.*`) are found by ESLint 8.57 and newer; on ESLint 9 and 10 they are the default.

```js
// eslint.config.mjs
import browserSecurity from 'eslint-plugin-browser-security';

export default [browserSecurity.configs.recommended];
```

Each preset is one flat config object: put it in the array as an element, do not spread it. Rule ids are prefixed `browser-security/`. Add it to the config you already have; do not remove other plugins. TypeScript files need a TypeScript parser in the config (`typescript-eslint`).

Use it alongside `eslint-plugin-security`, not instead of it: keep that plugin if the project has it. Measured overlap and the limits of both: https://eslint.interlace.tools/docs/getting-started/with-eslint-plugin-security

## Presets

| Preset        | Rules | Errors | Warnings |
| ------------- | ----- | ------ | -------- |
| `flagship`    | 1     | 1      | 0        |
| `recommended` | 33    | 32     | 1        |
| `strict`      | 46    | 46     | 0        |
| `xss`         | 2     | 2      | 0        |
| `storage`     | 1     | 1      | 0        |
| `postmessage` | 2     | 2      | 0        |
| `websocket`   | 1     | 1      | 0        |
| `cookies`     | 1     | 1      | 0        |

### `flagship`

1 rule:

- `no-postmessage-wildcard-origin` (error): Disallow using wildcard (*) as targetOrigin in postMessage calls.

### `recommended`

33 rules:

- `no-innerhtml` (error): Disallow dangerous innerHTML/outerHTML assignments that can lead to XSS.
- `no-eval` (error): Disallow eval(), Function(), and other code execution patterns.
- `require-postmessage-origin-check` (error): Require origin validation in postMessage event listeners.
- `no-postmessage-wildcard-origin` (error): Disallow using wildcard (*) as targetOrigin in postMessage calls.
- `no-postmessage-innerhtml` (error): Disallow using innerHTML or similar methods with postMessage data.
- `no-sensitive-localstorage` (error): Disallow storing sensitive data like passwords and keys in localStorage.
- `no-jwt-in-storage` (error): Disallow storing JWTs and other bearer credentials in localStorage or sessionStorage.
- `no-sensitive-sessionstorage` (error): Disallow storing sensitive data in sessionStorage.
- `no-sensitive-indexeddb` (error): Disallow storing sensitive data in IndexedDB.
- `no-sensitive-cookie-js` (error): Disallow storing sensitive data (passwords, keys, regulated identifiers) in cookies via JavaScript.
- `no-cookie-auth-tokens` (error): Disallow storing auth tokens in cookies via JavaScript.
- `require-cookie-secure-attrs` (error): Require Secure and SameSite attributes when setting cookies.
- `require-websocket-wss` (error): Require secure WebSocket connections (wss://) instead of unencrypted (ws://).
- `no-websocket-innerhtml` (error): Disallow using innerHTML or similar methods with WebSocket message data.
- `no-websocket-eval` (error): Disallow using eval() or Function() with WebSocket message data.
- `no-filereader-innerhtml` (error): Disallow using innerHTML or similar methods with FileReader data.
- `require-blob-url-revocation` (warn): Require revoking Blob URLs to prevent memory leaks.
- `no-dynamic-service-worker-url` (error): Disallow dynamic URLs in service worker registration.
- `no-worker-message-innerhtml` (error): Disallow using innerHTML with Web Worker message data.
- `no-unsafe-inline-csp` (error): Disallow 'unsafe-inline' in Content Security Policy.
- `no-unsafe-eval-csp` (error): Disallow 'unsafe-eval' in Content Security Policy.
- `detect-mixed-content` (error): Detect HTTP resources in HTTPS pages.
- `no-unencrypted-transmission` (error): Detects unencrypted data transmission (HTTP vs HTTPS, plain text protocols).
- `no-allow-arbitrary-loads` (error): Prevent configuration allowing insecure loads.
- `no-credentials-in-query-params` (error): Disallow credentials in URL query parameters.
- `no-http-urls` (error): Disallow hardcoded HTTP URLs (require HTTPS).
- `no-incomplete-url-sanitization` (error): Disallow URL substring tests and partial scheme denylists as security decisions.
- `no-insecure-redirects` (error): Detects open redirect vulnerabilities.
- `no-disabled-certificate-validation` (error): Prevent disabled SSL/TLS certificate validation.
- `require-https-only` (error): Enforce HTTPS for all external requests.
- `no-insecure-websocket` (error): Require secure WebSocket connections (wss://).
- `no-unvalidated-deeplinks` (error): Require validation of deep link URLs.
- `no-client-side-auth-logic` (error): Prevent authentication logic in client code.

### `strict`

Everything in `recommended` plus 13 more (some shared rules run at a different severity here):

- `no-clickjacking` (error): Detects clickjacking vulnerabilities and missing frame protections.
- `no-missing-cors-check` (error): Detects missing CORS validation (wildcard CORS, missing origin check).
- `no-missing-csrf-protection` (error): Detects missing CSRF token validation in POST/PUT/DELETE requests.
- `no-missing-security-headers` (error): Detects missing security headers in HTTP responses.
- `no-password-in-url` (error): Prevent passwords in URLs.
- `no-permissive-cors` (error): Prevent overly permissive CORS configuration.
- `no-sensitive-data-in-analytics` (error): Prevent PII being sent to analytics services.
- `no-sensitive-data-in-cache` (error): Prevent caching credential-bearing responses in the Cache Storage API.
- `no-tracking-without-consent` (error): Require consent before analytics tracking.
- `no-unescaped-url-parameter` (error): Detects unescaped URL parameters.
- `require-csp-headers` (error): Require Content Security Policy headers.
- `require-url-validation` (error): Enforce URL validation before navigation.
- `require-mime-type-validation` (error): Require MIME type validation for file uploads.

### `xss`

2 rules:

- `no-innerhtml` (error): Disallow dangerous innerHTML/outerHTML assignments that can lead to XSS.
- `no-eval` (error): Disallow eval(), Function(), and other code execution patterns.

### `storage`

1 rule:

- `no-sensitive-localstorage` (error): Disallow storing sensitive data like passwords and keys in localStorage.

### `postmessage`

2 rules:

- `require-postmessage-origin-check` (error): Require origin validation in postMessage event listeners.
- `no-postmessage-wildcard-origin` (error): Disallow using wildcard (*) as targetOrigin in postMessage calls.

### `websocket`

1 rule:

- `require-websocket-wss` (error): Require secure WebSocket connections (wss://) instead of unencrypted (ws://).

### `cookies`

1 rule:

- `no-sensitive-cookie-js` (error): Disallow storing sensitive data (passwords, keys, regulated identifiers) in cookies via JavaScript.

## Other Interlace plugins by dependency

If the project also depends on one of these, add the matching plugin the same way:

- `express`, `fastify`, `koa`, `@hapi/hapi`, `restify`, `hono`, `next`, `@nestjs/core`, `@nestjs/common`, `aws-lambda`, `@types/aws-lambda`, `@middy/core`, `commander`, `yargs`, `@oclif/core`, `@modelcontextprotocol/*`: `eslint-plugin-node-security`
- `express`: `eslint-plugin-express-security`
- `@nestjs/common`, `@nestjs/core`: `eslint-plugin-nestjs-security`
- `jsonwebtoken`, `jose`, `express-jwt`, `@nestjs/jwt`, `jwks-rsa`, `jwt-decode`: `eslint-plugin-jwt-security`
- `pg`, `pg-pool`, `pg-promise`, `postgres`, `slonik`: `eslint-plugin-postgresql-security`
- `mysql2`, `mysql`: `eslint-plugin-mysql-security`
- `mongodb`, `mongoose`: `eslint-plugin-mongodb-security`
- `better-sqlite3`, `sqlite3`: `eslint-plugin-sqlite-security`
- `knex`: `eslint-plugin-knex-security`
- `@prisma/client`, `prisma`: `eslint-plugin-prisma-security`
- `drizzle-orm`: `eslint-plugin-drizzle-security`
- `sequelize`: `eslint-plugin-sequelize-security`
- `typeorm`: `eslint-plugin-typeorm-security`
- `@supabase/supabase-js`: `eslint-plugin-supabase-security`
- `@modelcontextprotocol/*`: `eslint-plugin-mcp-sdk-security`
- `openai`, `@openai/agents`: `eslint-plugin-openai-security`
- `@anthropic-ai/sdk`, `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk`: `eslint-plugin-anthropic-security`
- `@google/genai`: `eslint-plugin-gemini-security`
- `ai`: `eslint-plugin-vercel-ai-security`
- `aws-lambda`, `@types/aws-lambda`, `@middy/core`: `eslint-plugin-lambda-security`

The full stack-to-plugin playbook (with config rendering and a proof step) is the `security-linting` skill: https://github.com/ofri-peretz/eslint/tree/main/skills/security-linting
